sites.name: Mu Cang Chai Terraced Fields Scenic Landscape
sites.event: A Special National Monument, famous for its terraced fields as beautiful as wood grain, especially during the watering season and the ripe rice season.

place.commune: La Pan Tan Commune, Che Cu Nha Commune, De Xu Phinh Commune

sites.name: Thac Ba Lake
sites.event: One of the three largest artificial lakes in Vietnam, likened to 'Ha Long on the mountain' with more than 1,300 large and small islands.

place.district: Yen Binh District, Luc Yen District

sites.name: Khau Pha Pass
sites.event: One of the 'Four Great Passes' of the Northwest, home to the famous 'Flying over the Golden Season' paragliding festival.

sites.name: Yen Bai Uprising Monument (Nguyen Thai Hoc Tomb)
sites.event: The resting place of patriot Nguyen Thai Hoc and his comrades in the Yen Bai Uprising (1930) against French colonialists.

sites.name: Muong Lo Field
sites.event: The second largest rice field in the Northwest region ('First Thanh, second Lo...'), the cradle of Black Thai culture with the Xoe Thai dance (an Intangible Cultural Heritage).

place.commune: Tan An Ward, Pu Trang Ward...

sites.name: Suoi Giang
sites.event: Famous for its centuries-old ancient Shan Tuyet tea forest and a year-round cool climate like Sapa.

sites.name: Dong Cuong Temple
sites.event: A sacred temple located by the Red River, dedicated to Mother Goddess De Nhi Thuong Ngan, an important spiritual destination in Mother Goddess worship.

sites.name: Ta Chi Nhu Peak
sites.event: The roof of Yen Bai (2,979m), a paradise for cloud hunting and admiring purple Chi Pau flowers in late autumn.

sites.name: Tram Tau Hot Springs
sites.event: A natural hot spring area nestled among terraced fields, an ideal resort destination.

sites.name: Van War Zone
sites.event: An important revolutionary base during the resistance war against the French, located in the border area between two districts.

place.commune: Viet Hong Commune (Tran Yen) and Dai Lich Commune (Van Chan)
place.district: Tran Yen District, Van Chan District

sites.name: Hang Te Cho Waterfall
sites.event: Known as one of the 'four great death zones' for backpackers, this is one of the most pristine and majestic waterfalls in the Northwest.

sites.name: Cu Vai Village
sites.event: A Mong ethnic village isolated on a high mountain peak, covered in clouds year-round, preserving its pristine beauty.
